text: dsh-ikun-pet 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的坤宠挂件，在回答进行中的 Deep diving 区域展示动画和进度。客户端把组件注入 conversation.input.dock，根据会话运行状态、工具调用、流式输出、等待状态、历史回合时长及目标回合信号估算进度，并按阶段切换动作与文案；回答完成后展示庆祝动画并请求宿主播放提示音。宿主提供精灵图 HTTP 路由、目标进度 RPC 和调试工具。适合希望在深潜回答时获得直观进度反馈的 DSH Web 用户。代码未声明 API Key 或外部账号要求。

dsh-ikun-pet adds an animated progress pet to the DSH Web dock during replies. It estimates progress from activity and goal rounds, changes animation by stage, and celebrates completion with a host played sound. The host serves the sprite sheet and handles RPCs. No API key or account is declared.

dsh-ikun-pet 的功能「深潜进度挂件」：会话运行时在 conversation.input.dock 显示宠物动画、阶段文案和进度条；会话空闲时挂件隐藏。
dsh-ikun-pet 的功能「自适应进度」：根据工具调用、流式输出、等待状态、历史回合时长及可用的目标回合进度估算当前进度，回答完成时才显示 100%。
dsh-ikun-pet 的功能「分档动画」：进度从等待、奔跑、工作、审阅到挥手，每 20% 切换动作与文案；完成后显示跳跃庆祝动画。
dsh-ikun-pet 的功能「完成提示音」：回答完成时客户端调用 Host RPC，宿主根据配置和音频文件状态启动系统播放器播放提示音。
dsh-ikun-pet 的功能「精灵图服务」：宿主读取本地 WebP 精灵图并注册 HTTP 路由，客户端取得路由 URL 后将精灵图用于逐帧动画。
dsh-ikun-pet 的 src/host.js 将精灵图和音频默认路径写为开发机绝对路径；补丁注释则提示素材默认取包内 assets。安装后需核对实际素材路径配置。

dsh-ikun-pet README · 🐤 dsh-ikun-pet · ikun Desktop Pet：> A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that fills the full row under the **"Deep diving..." status line** with an ikun pet during **every reply**:
> a `0% → 100%` progress bar, **a new animation and text every 20%**, and a jump celebration with a system-level "你干嘛~哎哟" voice cue at completion 🏀

dsh-ikun-pet README · ✨ Features：- **Only fills the deep-dive dock**: registered at `conversation.input.dock` — the full row directly below
  DSH's "Deep diving..." status line, between the conversation and the composer. Visible only while a
  session is `running` (deep diving); completely invisible the rest of the time.
- **The pet walks the progress bar**: the ikun pet walks from 3% to 97%, playing frame-by-frame on top of
  the progress bar (8 columns × 9 rows sprite-sheet contract).
- **A new stage every 20%**: six stages at 0/20/40/60/80/100, each switching both the animation and the
  text (see [docs/PROGRESS-STAGES.md](docs/PROGRESS-STAGES.md)).
- **Universal adaptive progress**: a layered estimation model — real anchors (0% start / 100% done) +
  real goal-round progress + self-calibration from this session's turn durations + activity pacing for
  tools/streaming/approval-waiting + a shrinking reserve. Short tasks run fast, long tasks run slow,
  waiting for your approval slows it down honestly, and it never fakes 100%
  (details in [docs/PROGRESS-STAGES.md](docs/PROGRESS-STAGES.md)).
- **Completion heard system-wide**: at 100% the host process plays "你干嘛~哎哟" (`assets/voice

dsh-ikun-pet README · 🚀 Install：**Option A: clone** (for tinkerers)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/eric-song-dev/dsh-ikun-pet && cd dsh-ikun-pet
dsh plugin add "$PWD" --profile web
```

**Option B: remote one-liner** (for users)

```bash
dsh plugin add github:eric-song-dev/dsh-ikun-pet --profile web

dsh-ikun-pet README · 🎬 Stage → animation → text：| Progress | Animation | Text |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 0% – 20% | waiting | 深潜启动！准备出发… |
| 20% – 40% | runRight | 正在收集线索… |
| 40% – 60% | working | 埋头苦干中… |
| 60% – 80% | review | 认真思考中… |
| 80% – 100% | wave | 快好啦！马上见结果~ |
| 100% (done) | jump | 完成啦！你干嘛~哎哟 🔉 (host plays the voice cue) |

dsh-ikun-pet README · ⚙️ Configuration (optional)：Everything lives in the plugin line's `config` inside the bundled `cordis.patch.yml`:
`spritePath` / `voicePath` / `playVoiceAtDone` / `playCommand` (assets default to the bundled `assets/`).

dsh-ikun-pet README · ⚙️ Configuration (optional)：- **Disable**: remove the `#` in front of `# disabled: true`, restart `dsh web` (put it back to re-enable)
- **Mute the voice**: `config.playVoiceAtDone: false` (the animated bar is unaffected)
- **Voice on Windows/Linux**: swap `playCommand` to PowerShell / ffplay (examples in the comments;
  macOS defaults to `afplay`, tested)

dsh-ikun-pet README · 🗑 Uninstall / 🔄 Update：```bash
dsh plugin remove dsh-ikun-pet --profile web     # uninstall (bundles are reconciled automatically), then restart dsh web

dsh-ikun-pet README · 🧪 Session-level install (dynamic plugin)：```bash
node scripts/build-package.mjs     # produces the ikun.package.json install payload
```

Hand the payload to your Agent to install via `cordis_define` + `cordis_run` — current session only.
⚠️ Don't run it alongside the permanent plugin (their sprite routes conflict).

dsh-ikun-pet README · 🛟 Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin line fails on restart | `node -e "require('dsh-ikun-pet')"` in the profile dir should succeed; reinstall if it doesn't |
| Dock not showing but routes work | hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R); make sure the dynamic plugin isn't enabled at the same time |
| No voice | check `config.playVoiceAtDone`; macOS uses `afplay`, other OSes need a different `playCommand` |
| Don't want it to load | add `disabled: true` to the plugin line and restart |
